title: Stefan Johnsson (1959-)
name: Stefan Johnsson
description: Degree at Göteborg University | Academy of Music and Drama. Degree of Master with a Major in Musicology at Örebro University. Member of the Swedish Composer Society FST. Principal trumpet in Borås Symfoniorkester Brass pedagogue at Borås Kulturskola
